fusions.name: Pincushion
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers at once, in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each one deals 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave its target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Cocoon
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ply Over Ply
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a layer on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per layer (42% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.
